title: Retrieve Link Content
description: Retrieves targeted content from web pages using LLM URL extraction. Can optionally output a second column containing a clean, human-readable text summary of the retrieved data.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name or list of input columns containing URLs or Scored Search Result dictionaries.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Name of the output column for the raw dictionaries. To output BOTH the raw dictionaries and the formatted text, provide a list of exactly two column names (e.g., [page_data, page_text]).

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key for the provider. Can also be set as an environment variable (e.g., GOOGLE_API_KEY).

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Optional custom system prompt to guide the extraction behavior and output format.

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: The specific model ID to use (default models/gemini-3-flash-preview).

parameters.name: output_format
parameters.description: The desired format for the extracted content.

parameters.name: threads
parameters.description: Number of concurrent threads for parallel processing (default 10).

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Retrieves targeted content from web pages using LLM URL extraction. Can optionally output a second column containing a clean, human-readable text summary of the retrieved data. ## Migrated examples #### Retrieve Structured Page Content This template extracts JSON content from a URL. Returned fields depend on the page, prompt, and retrieval model. ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - search.retrieve_link_content: input: - Product URL output: - Page Data api_key: Your Google API key client: google_url_context output_format: json prompt: Extract the product title and manufacturer. ```
##### Input Sample | Product URL | | --- | | https://example.com/products/6202 |
##### Output Sample | Product URL | Page Data | | --- | --- | | https://example.com/products/6202 | `{"title": "6202 Bearing", "manufacturer": "SKF"}` |
_Template based on the documented parameters; no published source example is currently available._
